sections.translation_zh:
确保系统开发方法能够向架构设计提供反馈。

采用众多成功的敏捷开发方法之一：

- 确保人员具备必要技能；
- 确保有适当的协作与治理，以交付期望的业务价值。

如何管理风险：

- 保持与架构描述的关联；
- 确保有充分反馈以评估对架构的符合性；
- 通过高效、敏捷的变更管理过程维护过渡架构。

source_units.text_en: 5.2.4. Develop Target
Ensure that the systems development method enables feedback to the architecture design.
Adopt one of the many successful Agile development methods:
• Make sure that people have the necessary skills
• Ensure that there is appropriate collaboration and governance to deliver the desired business value
How to manage risk:
• Maintain linkage to architecture descriptions
• Ensure sufficient feedback to assess conformance to architecture
• Maintain Transition Architectures through an efficient and Agile change management process

semantic_rules.statement_zh: 实现过程保留架构关联、符合性反馈、过渡架构和变更管理，并保障人员技能与协作治理。

sections.translation_zh:
（变更驱动因素）以往交付项目增量的经验。

治理应嵌入冲刺之中，并成为冲刺回顾与冲刺规划的一部分：

- 为解决方案构建提供指导，使其保持在护栏之内并遵循解决方案跑道；
  - 护栏可以是技术边界或约束，例如规定要使用的标准组件、性能与容量限制，或技术政策；
  - 跑道是未来系统构建冲刺将使用的架构定义或技术上层结构；
- 评估变更对更高层架构的影响；
- 基于每个冲刺（能力增量）的经验获取反馈，以演进更高层架构。

一旦解决方案实施开始，架构团队应细化用于检验对目标架构符合性的治理指标。这种符合性可由目标与关键结果（OKR）构成，以确保价值正在交付，并确保与标准和法规对齐。

如 O-AA™ 标准 [C208] 所定义，OKR 以具体成就与绩效改进来阐明公司优先级。目标（objectives）由清晰定义的定性变化构成，而关键结果（key results）是必须达成的具体、通常为定量的绩效目标。敏捷组织应每年设定 OKR，并按季度评估进展。

变更是敏捷交付的固有部分，架构治理有助于保持交付团队之间的一致性，以及与更高层架构的一致性。如果变更很大，可能需要转向（pivot），但应在首次高层迭代时进行评估，以确保最终目标与价值交付不丢失，并在必要时调整业务优先级与相互依赖关系。

source_units.text_en: 5.2.5. Govern and Manage Change
(Drivers for change) Experience with previously delivered project increments.
Governance should be embedded within sprints, and as part of sprint retrospectives and sprint planning:
• Provide guidance to solution construction to keep within guardrails and follow the solution runway
◦Guardrails may be technical boundaries or constraints such as specifying standard components
to be used, performance and capacity limits, or technical policies
◦The runway is the architectural definitions or technical superstructure that will be consumed in
future system construction sprints
• Assess the impact of change on higher-level architectures
• Gain feedback to evolve higher-level architectures based on experience of each sprint (capability increment)

Once solution implementation has started, the architecture team should refine the governance metrics that will be applied to test compliance against the Target Architecture. This compliance could be composed by Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) to ensure value is being delivered and also to ensure alignment with standards and regulations.

As defined in the O-AA™ Standard [C208], OKRs spell out the company’s priorities in terms of specific accomplishments and performance improvements. The objectives consist of a clearly defined qualitative change, while the key result is a specific, often quantitative performance target that must be met. Agile organizations should set OKRs annually and assess progress against them on a quarterly basis.

Change is an inherent part of Agile delivery, and architecture governance can help to maintain alignment between delivery teams and alignment with higher-level architectures. If a change is large, then a pivot may be necessary, but an assessment should be made at the first high-level iteration to be sure the final objective and value delivery is not lost, and if necessary to adjust business priorities and interdependencies.

semantic_rules.statement_zh: 治理嵌入冲刺、回顾与规划；护栏是边界约束，跑道是后续构建要消费的架构定义，两者不能互换。
治理指标可使用OKR表达价值与标准/法规对齐，但OKR不是全部符合性证据或合规认证。
本指南援引O-AA建议年度设定OKR、季度评估；保留其出处和语境，不将之伪称为所有TOGAF工作唯一法定节奏。
重大变更需回到高层评估最终目标、价值、业务优先级和依赖，不让局部冲刺自行改变企业战略。

sections.translation_zh:
在敏捷环境中，以及在已采用敏捷交付方法的支持性组织中，5.2 节所述活动很可能是持续管理、并行处理的过程，更关注成果，以架构作为支持产品交付的载体。

对于敏捷方法，要遵循的阶段相似，但执行方式不同。企业架构迭代支持这种产品定义与产品架构。

问题在战略层与分段层定义，然后在分段层与能力层定义目标，再在能力层由敏捷团队在架构师与能力架构定义的支持下部署目标。

如“架构层级与迭代”所述，在战略层定义高层架构规格——战略主题、史诗，用于指导后续问题定义。在分段层，待办列表与战略定义（问题定义）对齐地定义。该待办列表应进一步细化，产出将使用任何敏捷技术交付的冲刺待办列表。这种敏捷交付由支持敏捷解决方案交付的能力架构支撑。

source_units.text_en: 5.3. Architecture, Product Development, and Delivery

In an Agile environment and within supporting organizations that have adopted an Agile delivery approach, it is likely that the activities presented in Section 5.2 will be a continuously managed process handled in parallel and focusing more on the outcome with architecture as the vehicle to support product delivery.
For an Agile approach the stages to follow are similar but performed in a different way. Enterprise Architecture iterations support this product definition and product architecture.

The problem is defined at the Strategic and Segment level, then at the Segment and Capability level a target is defined, and at the Capability level a target is deployed by Agile teams supported by the architect and the Capability Architecture definition.

As explained in Architecture Levels and Iterations, at the Strategic level a high-level architecture specification is defined — strategic themes, epics, that will guide the subsequent problem definition. At the Segment level, the backlog is defined in alignment with the strategic definition (problem definition). This backlog should be refined further to produce the sprint backlog that will be delivered using any Agile technique. This Agile delivery is supported by a Capability Architecture supporting Agile solution delivery.

semantic_rules.statement_zh: 产品定义贯穿多层架构：战略/分段定义问题，分段/能力定义目标，能力层支持敏捷团队部署；不是三个领域或三个固定部门。

sections.title_en: 5.3.1. Identification of a New Need — Define and Identify the Problem
sections.title_zh: 5.3.1. 识别新需求——定义并识别问题
sections.translation_zh:
应用企业架构原则与利益相关者评估，辅以设计思维等其他技术，结合业务与技术的新趋势识别新的业务机会，采用由外而内的方法考虑客户需求，并评估竞争对手的做法。

如 O-AA 标准 [C208] 公理 2“由外而内思维”所述，敏捷架构应使用营销与设计方法，发现客户可能如何使用产品与服务。待完成工作分析、客户旅程映射与设计思维是敏捷企业使用的方法示例。设计思维是一种以人为本的方法，将人的认知与情感纳入价值定义的关键方面。

另一个重要考虑是开展业务就绪度评估，以采用可能与新识别业务需求相关的新兴技术，并考虑监管与合规——在定义问题时，遵循标准与公司原则也是关键考虑。

敏捷架构应识别企业价值流。价值应从客户立场来规定。应为每个产品或服务族识别从概念到上市、从订单到交付的价值流。企业架构应支持价值流定义，以及满足该需求所需的业务能力。

source_units.text_en: 5.3.1. Identification of a New Need — Define and Identify the Problem

Apply Enterprise Architecture principles and stakeholder assessment, supported by other techniques like design thinking, to identify new business opportunities considering the new trends in business and technology, taking an outside-in approach to consider customer demands, and assessing what competitors are doing.

As stated in Axiom 2, Outside-In Thinking, in the O-AA Standard [C208], Agile Architecture shall use marketing and design methods to discover how customers are likely to use products and services. Jobs- to-be-done analysis, customer journey mapping, and design thinking are examples of methods used by Agile enterprises. Design thinking, which is a human-centered approach, incorporates human cognition and emotion as key aspects of the value definition.

Another important consideration is to perform a business readiness assessment, to adopt a new emerging technology that might be related with the new business need identified, and also to consider regulatory and compliance — adherence to standards and corporative principles is also a key consideration while defining the problem.

Agile Architecture should identify the enterprise value streams. Value shall be specified from the standpoint of the customer. A value stream has to be identified for each product or service family from concept to launch and from order to delivery. Enterprise Architecture should support the value stream definition and also the business capabilities needed to fulfill the need.

semantic_rules.statement_zh: 新兴技术相关业务需要同时审视业务就绪、监管、标准和企业原则；趋势或客户兴趣不能代替采用决策证据。

sections.translation_zh:
一旦描述了问题空间，就必须交付更详细的架构规格，描述所需的业务、数据、应用与技术构建块——该规格将成为产品待办列表定义的输入。产品经理与产品负责人是此过程的关键利益相关者。

为提供敏捷方法，还需要对问题分段。

应应用分段架构与能力架构概念，把问题解耦为更小的部分，使规格以敏捷方式交付。

架构中描绘的特性将有助于确定产品待办列表的优先级，并识别任何相互依赖关系，从而便于定义冲刺待办列表。

架构规格完成后，将提供输入以定义 SBB，并遵循分区概念塑造最终解决方案——该解决方案定义是冲刺待办列表定义的输入，并构成支持敏捷实施的有意架构的基础。

一旦敏捷团队基于架构描述开始交付过程，企业架构团队应细化用于检验符合性的治理指标。这种符合性可通过 OKR 构成，以确保价值正在交付，并确保与标准和监管合规对齐。

治理活动不应孤立进行，因此每当敏捷团队交付一项输出，都应进行回顾，治理过程应成为该冲刺迭代回顾与规划的一部分。

另一方面，变更管理也应在整个过程中持续进行，因为变更可能影响上述任何迭代。因此，应以动态方式识别这些变更，以便快速应用变更，避免过程进一步延误。

如果变更过大或具有颠覆性，则应在首次高层迭代进行分析，以确保最终目标与价值交付不丢失，并能对优先级与相互依赖关系作出适当调整。

敏捷架构应遵循的一个重要概念是有意架构，它规定一组有目的、有计划的架构策略与举措，以增强解决方案设计、性能与可用性，并为团队间设计与实施同步提供指导。

在图 5-4 中，有意架构作为能力架构规格的一部分交付，旨在提供支持实施的护栏。




战略架构的输出为定义产品待办列表提供输入，产品待办列表在分段架构中进一步详细定义。在能力架构层，定义冲刺待办列表，以及将指导实施（部署目标）的有意架构。

变更管理将处理任何新需求与特性，并支持产品待办列表的细化与排序，以便将其分配到不同发布中。

source_units.text_en: 5.3.2. Define Target

Once the problem space has been described then a more detailed architecture specification has to be delivered to describe the Business, Data, Application, and Technology building blocks needed — this specification will be the input for a product backlog definition. Product managers and product owners are key stakeholders in this process.
In order to provide an Agile approach, it is also necessary to segment the problem.
The Segment and Capability Architecture concepts should be applied to decouple the problem into smaller pieces so that the specifications will be delivered in an Agile way.
The features depicted in the architecture will be useful to define priorities for the product backlog and to identify any interdependencies that will facilitate the definition of the sprint backlog.

Once the architecture specifications have been finished, they will provide the input to define the SBBs and to shape the final solution following the partitions concept — this solution definition is the input for the sprint backlog definition and conforms the basis for the intentional architecture that will support Agile implementation.

Once the Agile teams start the delivery process based on the architecture descriptions, Enterprise Architecture teams should refine the governance metrics that will be applied to test compliance. This compliance could be composed through OKRs to ensure value is being delivered and also to ensure alignment with standards and regulatory compliance.

Governance activity should not be made in isolation, so every time an Agile team delivers an output a retrospective should be made, and the governance process should be part of that sprint iteration retrospective and planning.

On the other hand, change management should also continue during the whole process since changes could have an impact in any of the iterations described above. Therefore, these changes should be identified in a dynamic way so changes can be applied quickly to avoid further delays in the process.

If a change is too big or disruptive, then analysis at the first high-level iteration should be carried out to be sure the final objective and value delivery is not lost and the proper adjustments in priorities and interdependencies can be made.

An important concept to follow for Agile Architecture is intentional architecture, which specifies a set of purposeful, planned architectural strategies and initiatives to enhance solution design, performance, and usability and provide guidance for inter-team design and implementation synchronization.
In Figure 5-4, intentional architecture is delivered as part of the Capability Architecture specification and it is aimed to provide guardrails to support implementation.

The output of the Strategic Architecture gives input to define the product backlog that is defined in further detail in the Segment Architecture. At the Capability Architecture level, the spring backlog is defined and also the intentional architecture that will guide implementation (deploy target).
Change management will address any new requirements and features and will support the refinement and prioritization for the product backlog, for them to be distributed in different releases.

source_units.text_en: 5.3.3. Projects versus Products

Project and product management are closely related, but in general product management is a broader discipline than project management. Product management covers the full lifecycle of discovery, development, delivery, long-term support and maintenance, and disposal, although disposal is often a relatively trivial step with digital products. Within this product lifecycle, there are likely to be a number of projects and processes invoked; e.g., a project for each major product deliverable, and a process to handle support requests from product users. source_units.text_en: 5.4. Architecture Artifacts

The TOGAF Standard — Architecture Content describes the TOGAF Content Framework. In general, the artifacts and their relationships apply equally to Agile delivery as to other delivery lifecycle approaches. However, the tooling and format may need to be adapted for Agile delivery.

sections.translation_zh: 使用企业架构工具可以加速 TOGAF 架构制品的实施。这些工具可以实时收集业务运营数据，并构建/增强架构模型。利用人工智能（AI）算法，它们可以优化模型。这些工具还通过展示采用各种数字技术的影响，支持用户之间的构思与协作。最重要的是，这些工具使企业架构能够量化和度量架构的转型变化。

source_units.text_en: 5.4.1. Automation of Enterprise Architecture

The implementation of TOGAF architecture artifacts can be accelerated with the use of Enterprise Architecture tools. These tools can collect business operational data in real-time and build/enhance architecture models. Using Artificial Intelligence (AI) algorithms, they can optimize the models. The tools also enable ideation and collaboration between the users by showing the impact of adopting various digital technologies. Most importantly, these tools enable the Enterprise Architecture to quantify and measure transformation changes to the architecture.

sections.translation_zh: 制品及其模板应包含与其目的相一致的最小内容，不多不少。本文档前几节所述的渐进式、迭代式架构开发，可通过使用一系列详细程度和/或范围递增的模板来产出制品来实现。例如，阶段 B（业务架构）的第一个制品可能只包含基线架构；对于大型项目，还可进一步分为一个概览制品，随后是一系列描述更详细的制品。

source_units.text_en: 5.4.2. Minimalistic Artifacts

Artifacts and their templates should contain the minimum content that is consistent with their purpose, and no more. The progressive, iterative development of architecture described in previous sections of this document can be realized by producing the artifacts using a series of templates of increasing detail and/or scope. For example, a first artifact from Phase B, Business Architecture, might contain just the Baseline Architecture, or for large projects, this could be further divided into an overview artifact followed by a series of artifacts with more detailed descriptions.

sections.title_zh: 5.5. 支持产品架构的 TOGAF ADM 阶段与制品
sections.translation_zh:
- **预备阶段**
  - 定义企业架构组织能力与成熟度模型，以支持优化的业务、数据、应用与技术架构，尤其是当它们响应市场颠覆性趋势时；例如，通过新价值主张使组织演进为数字产品供给，以及为其交付进行客户旅程映射
  - 定义企业架构原则与治理框架，以支持架构愿景
  - 定义组织层面所需的变更，以调整组织能力与结构，从而实施业务价值，并以高效、有效的方式支持开发与部署；例如，在必要时调整以满足应用/系统/组合交付的敏捷方法

    可能需要新的组织结构模型，这意味着新角色、技能与能力，以及一个跨组织单元、旨在建立自主自赋能敏捷团队的新组织模型。这将使组织能够扩展其敏捷开发。

  - 所需制品：
    - 组织映射；见《TOGAF® 系列指南：组织映射》[G206]
    - 如何建立企业架构能力；见《TOGAF® 系列指南：TOGAF® 领导者建立与演进 EA 能力指南》[G184]
  - 组织原则——审查并在需要时调整
- **阶段 A：架构愿景**
  - 定义与组织战略和使命一致的业务价值主张与战略
  - 如果需要重新定义整个公司战略以满足新趋势，则需在架构愿景阶段处理
  - 所需制品：
    - 战略与动机模型，描绘产品战略以支持能力层决策
  - 额外支持：
    - 如何调整 ADM 以支持战略架构与决策；见《TOGAF® 系列指南：遵循 TOGAF® ADM 开发企业架构的实践者方法》[G186]
    - 价值流与业务能力建模、业务模型指南，用于产品的高层模型；见《TOGAF® 系列指南集：业务架构》[T190]
  - 在此阶段，非常重要的是把企业架构设想为模块化的，使其交付与支持更高效、更易于变更
- **阶段 B：业务架构**
  - 用于定义旨在解决问题空间、构建解决方案空间的关键特性与收益
  - 需求定义并转化为功能与非功能需求——并为每个产品定义目标市场、特性与价值主张
  - 设计交付产品所需的价值流与业务能力
  - 所需制品：
    - 价值流、业务能力，与组织映射关联，信息映射以识别所需关键信息——BMC 等业务模型以及业务运营模型
  - 为不同受众建模客户旅程；见《TOGAF® 系列指南集：业务架构》[T190]
- **阶段 C：信息系统架构**
  - 交付产品特性并处理相关客户细分所需的信息——在产品的不同交付阶段构建与支持产品所需的信息，以及向目标受众与客户营销和销售产品所需的信息：客户画像
  - 用所需信息与所需数据分析细化客户旅程图
- **阶段 C：应用架构**
  - 将产品功能特性与产品推向市场所需的能力进行映射
  - 所需制品：
    - 将功能映射到应用组件与服务
  - 应用基于微服务和松耦合组件的架构模式，使其更易于开发、交付与维护，并具有清晰的集成点；其关键在于追求有效的集成与交付
- **阶段 D：技术架构**
  - 支持产品开发、交付与维护的技术或技术平台——方法取决于产品类型：如果是应用或软件系统，则是支持应用组件与服务的技术平台；如果是基于云的服务，则应调整方法以满足该需求

Architecture Vision
◦Define the changes needed at the organizational level to adapt the organization capabilities and

structure to implement the business value and to support development and deployment in an efficient and effective way; for example, adapting to fulfill Agile methodologies for application/system/portfolio delivery when and if necessary

A new model for organizational structure might be needed which implies new roles, skills, and capabilities and a new organizational model cross-cutting organizational units and aimed at having autonomous self-empowered Agile teams. This will allow organizations to scale their Agile development.

▪How to set an Enterprise Architecture capability; refer to the TOGAF® Series Guide: The

◦Organizational principles — review and adapt if needed

◦Artifacts needed:
▪Strategy and motivation models, depicting product strategy to support Capability-level
decision-making
◦Additional support:
▪How to adapt the ADM to support strategy architecture and decision taking; refer to the

solution space
◦Requirements definition and translation into functional and non-functional requirements —
